ga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
ga.text:
Selling, general and administrative expenses primarily include salaries and related costs for roles not directly

attributable to the production of goods sold, such as sales and marketing, legal, finance and accounting, information

technology, human resources and certain other employees. Selling, general and administrative expenses also include

a portion of our depreciation, depletion, accretion and amortization expense related to property, plant and

equipment, intangible assets not directly attributable to the production of goods sold, acquisition-related transaction

costs, the service cost component of defined benefit pension plan and other postretirement benefit plan expenses,

operating lease expenses and finance lease expenses. Additionally, Selling, general and administrative expenses also

include expense allocations for certain corporate, infrastructure and other shared services provided by Parent on a

centralized basis, including but not limited to accounting and financial reporting, treasury, tax, legal, human

resources, information technology, insurance, employee benefits and other shared services.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text:
Prior to the Spin-Off, our income tax provision was prepared using the separate return method. The separate

return method applies the concepts of ASC Topic 740, Income Taxes, to the standalone financial statements

of each member of the combined group as if the group members were separate taxpayers. The calculation of

our income taxes using the separate return method requires judgment and use of both estimates and

allocations. Furthermore, current obligations for taxes that may arise under the separate return method where

our operations were included in tax returns with the activities of Holcim are deemed settled with Holcim as a

component of Net parent investment for purposes of our historical consolidated financial statements. As a

result, the income taxes presented in our historical consolidated financial statements may not be indicative of

the income taxes that we will generate in the future. Following the Spin-Off, our income tax provision is

calculated based on our operating footprint, as well as tax return elections and assertions. Given that prior to

the Spin-Off our U.S. and Canadian operations were not included in Holcim’s tax filings, U.S. and Canadian tax

returns will be filed on a full-year basis in 2025.

wc.heading: Working Capital
wc.text:
Due to the seasonal nature of our business, we typically use cash as working capital increases in the first half

of the year. This increase is driven by higher sales activity and the related impact in accounts receivable,

increased inventory from production, and higher maintenance activities at the beginning of our production

season. In the second half of the year, working capital becomes a source of cash as revenue activity peaks,

drawing down inventory, and collecting outstanding accounts receivable. We may periodically utilize

customer early‑payment programs and adjust the timing of certain payments.

tax.heading: Income Taxes
tax.text:
Prior to the Spin-Off, our income tax provision was prepared using the separate return method. The separate

return method applies the concepts of ASC Topic 740, Income Taxes, to the standalone financial statements

of each member of the combined group as if the group members were separate taxpayers. The calculation of

our income taxes using the separate return method requires judgment and use of both estimates and

allocations. Furthermore, current obligations for taxes that may arise under the separate return method where

our operations were included in tax returns with the activities of Holcim are deemed settled with Holcim as a

component of Net parent investment for purposes of our historical consolidated financial statements. As a

result, the income taxes presented in our historical consolidated financial statements may not be indicative of

the income taxes that we will generate in the future. Following the Spin-Off, our income tax provision is

calculated based on our operating footprint, as well as tax return elections and assertions. Given that prior to

the Spin-Off our U.S. and Canadian operations were not included in Holcim’s tax filings, U.S. and Canadian tax

returns will be filed on a full-year basis in 2025.

metrics.label: Free cash flow margin
metrics.formula: (Operating cash flow − cash CapEx) / revenue

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.formula: Operating cash flow / positive net income

metrics.label: Stock compensation / revenue
metrics.formula: Stock compensation / revenue; not an extra deduction from GAAP earnings

metrics.label: R&D / revenue
metrics.formula: R&D expense / revenue; investment intensity, not a quality verdict

metrics.label: Cash CapEx / revenue
metrics.formula: Cash CapEx / revenue; excludes noncash additions

metrics.label: Accrual ratio
metrics.formula: (Net income − operating cash flow) / average assets; not annualized

metrics.label: Return on average assets
metrics.formula: Net income / average assets; not annualized

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.formula: Current assets / current liabilities

reserves.name: Allowance for doubtful accounts
reserves.what: set aside for customer invoices that may not be collected
reserves.label: FY2024

reserves.name: Product warranty reserve
reserves.what: accrued for expected repair and replacement costs of products already sold
reserves.label: FY2025

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
